about: Polyhedra regression set: the structures of the 315-structure stress run with the polyhedra CrysViz draws for each with default settings (chemical filter and cage detection on). Keys are "<centre>: <corners>" or "cage: <corners>", corner compositions sorted by element; values count the polyhedra drawn, periodic copies at the cell boundary included. Checked by tests/polygolden*.test.js on the WASM and the JS path; regenerate after an intended change with POLY_GOLDEN_UPDATE=1 (see tools/browsertest/polygolden.js). Sources: the AFLOW Encyclopedia of Crystallographic Prototypes (part 1) as shipped with pymatgen, pymatgen's test structures, and hand-made cases (diopside, Cr(CO)6, ferrocene, Prussian blue analogue, portlandite, C60 fullerite, dodecahedrane).

structures.name: aflow066_UB12
structures.note: Three 12-vertex cages: the B12 cuboctahedron and two empty truncated-tetrahedral holes between clusters.

structures.name: aflow077_CeNiC2
structures.note: Judgement call: two Ni at 3.07 Å stay corners of Ce (bridging C at 0.915 of their distance, rule threshold 0.9).

structures.name: aflow107_KAsSe2
structures.note: Known limit: one As corner on K (the As faces K with its lone pair; no Se lies between).

structures.name: aflow122_Si
structures.note: AFLOW lists two cage-guest sites as Si, so its cages are filled and no cages are drawn.

structures.name: aflow209_Cr4Fe4Ni4PdRh2
structures.description: sigma phase CrFe, different elements used to distinguish Wyckoff positions

structures.name: aflow270_ZrPbO3
structures.note: Known limit: one Pb corner on Zr (Pb faces Zr across its long ~3.2 Å Pb–O bonds, past the default cutoff).

structures.name: aflow278_Li
structures.description: High pressure (38.9 GPa) phase of lithium

structures.name: hand_C60_fullerite
structures.description: C60 fullerite, fcc a = 14.17 Å, standard orientation
